prompt:
Hi, I'm finally trying to get my weekly cooking organized. I've written up everything I need in a file at ~/meal_planning_request.txt — it has the meals I like to make, what my family needs diet-wise, which nights are too busy to cook anything complicated, and the pantry items I always have on hand so I don't buy them again.

Can you please set up a proper meal planning workspace for me based on that file? I need:
1. A database of those specific meals (with all their details)
2. A full weekly plan for Week 11 of 2024 using those meals
3. A shopping list file named week-11-shopping.md for the week

Make sure the shopping list actually reflects what I need to BUY (not what I already have in my pantry), and groups things sensibly so grocery shopping is easy.
